verdict.rationale: Pika documents its own Upscale app, which adds resolution to an image or video, so the upscale-to-final half of the story is a first-party capability. Nothing in the pack describes a fast, cheaper draft or preview mode, or a workflow for picking a take and then upscaling it. Missing for 10: a documented cheaper/faster draft mode, a draft-to-final upscale workflow for a chosen take, credit-cost differences between draft and final, and hands-on corroboration of upscale quality.

support.subject: As a creator, I can draft fast in a cheaper mode and upscale the chosen take to final quality
